pages.text: Everyone spawns in the same village: the $(bold)capital$(), the last old town alive. It has a bell, villagers with trades, beds and bounty boards. It is the first market and the first thing raiders come for.$(br2)Claim a bed early. There is no fast travel; the way home matters. Almost every other old stone village is a ruin ($(l:patchouli:story/dead_towns)The Dead Towns$()).

$(bold)Day one checklist:$()$(br)- Wood, a crafting table, a bed in the capital$(br)- Check the season (sky colour, or craft a calendar)$(br)- Food: villager farms are fair game, replant what you take$(br)- A campfire before nightfall: three sticks make a $(l:patchouli:land/warmth)fire drill$()

$(bold)First night:$() stay in town, indoors. Mobs here are tougher and smarter than you remember, and the village guards will not chase them for you.$(br2)Mark the capital on your $(l:patchouli:tools/atlas)atlas$() before you leave it. The capital will grow as the server does; nothing you build there is wasted.

$(bold)Dying$() leaves a corpse holding everything you carried. Walk back and right-click it. Nothing despawns, but somebody else can loot it, so tell a friend where you fell.$(br2)Hunger is vanilla plus AppleSkin (hover food to see what it restores). There is no thirst. The cold is real in winter: see $(l:patchouli:land/warmth)Staying Warm$().
